paper_title: Search for Axionlike-Particle-Induced Prompt Gamma-Ray Emission from Extragalactic Core-Collapse Supernovae with the Fermi Large Area Telescope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (y-axis plotted as g_agamma in units of 10^-11 GeV^-1; axis multiplier applied)
notes: Fermi-LAT search for ALP-induced prompt gamma-ray bursts from 20 extragalactic core-collapse SNe (Meyer & Petrushevska 2020, arXiv:2006.06722). Main result: exclusion of g_agamma > 2.6(+2.0/-0.7)e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a < 3e-10 eV at 95% CL, assuming 10 M_sun progenitors, NiCo optical light curve model, and JF12 GMF model. Limit is valid under the assumption that at least one SN was in the LAT field of view (probability 88.5%). Limits extend to arbitrarily low masses since Paγ in the Galactic B-field is mass-independent for m_a ≲ 0.5 neV; lower mass endpoint of 1e-12 eV chosen to represent this flat regime (plot range ~0.1-10 neV). Limits degrade above ~1 neV but detailed shape is only in Fig. 2, not tabulated. Systematic range across model choices: (2.1-3.2)e-11 GeV^-1; 40 M_sun progenitor gives 7.9e-12 GeV^-1. Not a dark matter haloscope — no local DM density assumed. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 34)) | Vision: Traced the median observed 95% CL upper limit (blue solid line) from Fig. 2, the combined limit from stacking 20 extragalactic core-collapse SNe (10 M_sun progenitors, NiCo light-curve model, JF12 GMF). Flat plateau at g_agamma = 2.6e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a < 3e-10 eV, matching the quoted result in the text (g_agamma > (2.6+2.0-0.7)e-11 GeV^-1 excluded). Limit degrades at higher mass as Milky Way conversion probability P_agamma drops, reaching the top of the plot (~2e-10 GeV^-1) near ~9 neV. Not a dark matter search (SN Primakoff production), so no DM density assumed.
